name: VWAP snap-back
thesis: Morning moves stretched far from VWAP tend to revert toward it - frequent small wins.
rules: In the morning, when price is stretched N ATR (or N std-dev bands) from session VWAP, fade back toward VWAP. Stop beyond the stretch extreme; target VWAP or part of the way.
